one_line: U.S. export rules and hardware shortages impact global AI chip supplies and data center financing, while labs face governance, security, and policy challenges.

themes.title: Export controls and hardware supply constraints
themes.text: New U.S. export controls and chip shortages have halted server shipments to Southeast Asia, stalled billions in data center loans, and extended wait times for Nvidia's B300 chips. Additionally, S&P is considering a credit downgrade for Nvidia following management changes, while the Netherlands plans to resist U.S. legislation restricting ASML sales in China.

stories.headline: Pentagon officials discussed using Defense Production Act over Nvidia CEO role
US chip curbs stall billions in data center loans tied to Chinese firms
S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance risks
Nvidia stops shipping AI servers to four Southeast Asian countries
Netherlands seeks to block US MATCH Act restricting ASML China sales
NVIDIA B300 AI chip orders face up to 40‑week wait; RTX 60 GPU may slip past 2027

themes.title: AI security and unauthorized data access
themes.text: State-backed hackers from China and North Korea have integrated the AI penetration testing tool Artex into their workflows. Meanwhile, confidential data sent to Chinese startup MiniMax was accessed by unidentified parties despite requests that the data not be stored.

stories.headline: China and North Korean state-backed hackers add AI tool Artex to their arsenals
Confidential data sent to Chinese AI startup MiniMax accessed by unknown parties

themes.title: Industry restructuring and policy updates
themes.text: SAP plans to eliminate at least 10,000 positions to shift toward artificial intelligence, and ElevenLabs entered early talks for a 2027 funding round at a $33 billion valuation. New York signed a five-year ban on AI chatbot toys, and OpenAI corrected a launch-day billing error for its new models.

stories.headline: SAP prepares plan to eliminate at least 10,000 positions for AI shift
ElevenLabs in early talks for 2027 funding round at $33B target valuation
New York governor signs five-year ban on AI chatbot toys
OpenAI fixes billing error, usage limits hit 40% faster on Astra, 25% faster on Sol

themes.title: India advances AI regulations and models
themes.text: India's Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology announced that upcoming AI regulation papers are in their final stages. The launch coincided with the release of the Chariot-1 model suite and BharatGen's Patram 1.5 vision-language model.

stories.headline: IndiaAI regulation papers in final stages and releasing soon: MeitY
BharatGen launches Patram 1.5, a 7B vision-language model for documents
Chariot AI unveils Chariot-1 LLM and speech models under IndiaAI Mission
